Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
I am very happy to accept your offer of [£25 ](/topic/160)for the Australian edition of [Chantry House](/book/186).
I wish I could disinter A Citizen’s account of the Bristol riots of 1832.[^1] It is referred to in the Life of Bishop Gray and said to be excellent; but I could not get it from the [London Library](/organisation/29), and I wish I could see it before the proofs of that Chapter of Chantry House are irrevocable.

Yours very truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Perhaps John Eagles, The Bristol riots, their causes, progress, and consequences.

By a citizen (Bristol, Gutch and Martin 1832).
